coverage.reason: VRRM (40V), I(AV) (3.0A), VF at 3.0A/25C (0.55V max), and reverse leakage IR at 25C/125C (0.5mA/5mA max) are all primary-source confirmed from the MDD datasheet ratings table for the SS34 column.

D3's -13.5V inverting-rail reverse-voltage stress (Vin + |Vout| = 28.5V) leaves an 11.5V margin against the 40V VRRM rating, a smaller but still positive margin than D1/D2's non-inverting Vin-only stress (15V, 25V margin).

The datasheet gives only a single VF@3.0A/TA=25C maximum rating plus a qualitative per-family forward-characteristic curve; no numeric VF-vs-temperature coefficient is tabulated, so a temperature-derated VF value needs bench characterization or curve digitization.
